text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for giving me time 
off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I spent yesterday strolling 
through art museums and the second-hand 
bookstore district, having a very 
meaningful time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With the spare time, I also devised a menu 
for independent training. ...Could you 
spare some time after this?

It seems Mejiro Ardan was able to enjoy 
her day off in her own way!
